recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed unless a later OO decision reopens the type split for NutritionOrder instruction elements.
issue_request: FHIR-39584 was a Published OO change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked whether NutritionOrder.oralDiet.instruction should be markdown and also named NutritionOrder.supplement.instruction and NutritionOrder.enteralFormula.administrationInstruction. Jira comments and OO minutes clarify that only enteralFormula.administrationInstruction should be markdown.
initial_application: Commit 6a8ea8b6bed0c4ebafcd1afde31173eee8607965 applied FHIR-39584 by changing source/nutritionorder/structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml so NutritionOrder.enteralFormula.administrationInstruction uses markdown instead of string. No change was intended for oralDiet.instruction or supplement.instruction because the work group found those elements should remain short strings.
additional_context: FHIR-38714 prompted review of string elements that may need markdown. NutritionOrder is active in source/fhir.ini, and the 2023-02-06 OO minutes explicitly record that only enteralFormula.administrationInstructions should be markdown while oralDiet and supplement instructions stay short text strings. Zulip searches for NutritionOrder markdown terms found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active StructureDefinition source already has oralDiet.instruction and supplement.instruction typed as string and enteralFormula.administrationInstruction typed as markdown.

related_jiras.note: Prompted review of string elements for possible markdown conversion and framed the NutritionOrder-specific question, but it was not itself decided in this worker.
